Vantage Investment Partners Increases Position in At&T (T); Buckingham Asset Management Trimmed Its Position in Facebook (FB) by $745,536 as Stock Price Declined
May 16, 2018 - By Clifton Ray
Buckingham Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 2.24% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Buckingham Asset Management Llc sold 4,236 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 184,861 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $32.62M, down from 189,097 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Buckingham Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $533.54 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.24% or $2.32 during the last trading session, reaching $184.32. About 14.26M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
Vantage Investment Partners Llc increased its stake in At&T Corp (T) by 5.16% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Vantage Investment Partners Llc bought 15,258 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 311,116 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $12.10 million, up from 295,858 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Vantage Investment Partners Llc who had been investing in At&T Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $197.07B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.31% or $0.1 during the last trading session, reaching $32.09. About 26.51M shares traded. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 15.88% since May 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.43% the S&P500.
